by_band_caveat: Band perplexity is confounded with time, and badly. The curriculum gates B0 to the opening steps and B5 to the end, so a band's loss reflects how old the model was when it saw that band at least as much as how hard the band is. Expect it to run *backwards* -- lowest numbers on the hardest bands -- and do not read it as a difficulty measurement. The band figure is only interpretable within a stage, which is what by_lane_by_stage is for.

eos_prediction.note: EOS is the document boundary. If its perplexity does not fall, the model is not learning where documents end, and packed sequences will bleed one document into the next at inference.

what_this_is: Token-level and sample-level loss attributed back to shard, document, lane, band and role. The mean loss is the training signal; everything below it is the part that is normally discarded.
